messages:
Jules: Quick poll — who else thinks the ketchup bottle in the kitchen is plotting against us? :zipper_mouth_face:
Tara: 100% plotting. It only dispenses when you're already late. :rage:
Ben: Plot twist: the ketchup is unionized with the coffee machine. They demand better breaks. :coffee::tomato:
Ada: The ketchup has a sticky note that says 'Do not open before 10am' and I refuse to be the one who breaks it.
Jules: @Tara, you witnessed it squirt sideways yesterday, right? I have video (low quality, dramatic zoom).
Tara: I do. I'll post the evidence after lunch. It clearly targeted my sandwich. :eyes:
Ben: Can we give it a codename? 'Agent Squeeze'? 'Red Phantom'?
Ada: 'Red Phantom' sounds like a Broadway villain. I'm Team Agent Squeeze.
Jules: Officially naming it 'Agent Squeeze' — may we have a moment of silence for all untreated condiments. :older_man_tipping_hand:
deploy-bot: Reminder: kitchen stove maintenance scheduled tomorrow 08:00 — please remove personal items.
Tara: Thanks for the heads up, @deploy-bot. Also, is Agent Squeeze considered a personal item? Asking for a sandwich.
Ben: If it retaliates during maintenance we call it an incident. Pager rotation: @Jules on call for condiment containment. :rotating_light:
Ada: I made a tiny laminated 'containment protocol' and taped it to the shelf. See attached (it says 'Do not feed after midnight').
Jules: Love it. Next step: commemorative sticker. I can photoshop an ominous silhouette.
Tara: Please no more stickers in the snack drawer. We still have 'The Great Staple Incident' scar tissue.
Ben: That was legendary. Also, can we get a tiny hazmat suit for Agent Squeeze? For... dignity.
Ada: Meeting adjourned. Meeting minutes: 1) Name condiment 2) Prepare containment 3) Maintain dignity 4) Buy more mayo (in case things escalate).
Jules: Closing thread: who wants to be co-sponsor of the containment protocol? :raised_hands:
Tara: I'm in.
Ben: Count me in.
Ada: I'll make the sticker mockup.
Jules: Perfect. I'll buy the tiny caution tape.
